title: Mega Man 3
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man 3 adds the slide and Rush. Press Down + Jump to slide. There is still no charged Buster. Rush Coil is available from the start.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.
The bosses form two weakness loops. Top Man and Snake Man are the Buster entry points in this route. After all eight clears, four stages reopen with Doc Robot fights before Wily’s fortress.
routeIntro: Start with Top, complete the five-boss loop, then enter the Snake–Gemini–Needle loop. Keep Rush energy for the later Doc Robot stages.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: Clear all Robot Masters, check the utility items listed above, and refill the weapons needed for the final stages.

sections.title: Doc Robot return stages
paragraphs: Needle: use Spark Shock or Magnet Missile on the Air copy, then Hard Knuckle on Crash. Refill Rush Jet before the long flight.
Gemini: use Shadow Blade on Flash and Bubble. Shadow: Needle Cannon or Hard Knuckle on Wood, then Shadow Blade on Heat.
Spark: Shadow Blade on Metal, then Search Snake or Gemini Laser on Quick. Break Man afterward can be handled with ordinary shots.

sections.title: Wily’s fortress
paragraphs: Use Hard Knuckle on Kamegoro Maker’s turtles and Hard Knuckle on Yellow Devil’s open eye. Search Snake works against the vulnerable Holograph Mega Man.
Reuse the boss weaknesses in the rematches. Attack Wily Machine’s first form with Spark Shock, then its raised cockpit with Hard Knuckle or Rush-assisted Buster shots.
Gamma: climb using Rush Coil, damage the exposed target with Hard Knuckle, then reach Wily and use Top Spin or Search Snake.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Rush Jet is controllable; take time to line up a landing instead of treating it like Mega Man 2’s straight sled.
Save an E-Tank for a late boss rather than using it to refill a small amount of missing health.
